posts.title: Some thoughts on hosting email
posts.description: Generally speaking, email isn't as hard as its reputation would suggest. Yes, big-tech providers will occasionally send my messages to spam... but paying for commercial email doesn't guarantee delivery: emails within a single provider are generally safe, but in my experience, big-tech to other big-tech has a ~75% chance.
